speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe exactly when your double vision and muscle weakness began, and whether they worsen during the day or after physical activity. Do you notice any drooping of your eyelids or slurred speech?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and improving with rest is highly suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder, such as Myasthenia Gravis. To confirm this, I need to see if your specific eye muscles are affected; can you describe exactly which direction your double vision occurs when you look up or down? Also, have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or closing your eyes completely? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibodies; REQUEST IMAGES: Facial_Muscle_Strength_Assessment

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had trouble swallowing or slurred speech. I also have not noticed breathing difficulty, and the symptoms started gradually about a month ago.

speaker: Patient
text: The weakness is clearly worse with exertion and better after rest. I have not noticed muscle wasting or weight loss. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand your concern, but to confirm Myasthenia Gravis and rule out other causes like Lambert-Eaton or botulism, I must first know if your eyelids droop when you open them and if you experience any difficulty swallowing or speaking. Please confirm if you have had any recent infections or if you are currently taking any medications, as these can influence the results.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
